hero.description: I'm a PHP Laravel & Backend Developer. I build scalable, reliable, modern web applications and powerful backend solutions that businesses can grow on.

about.lead: I design and build the server-side of web products: clean architecture, dependable APIs and databases that stay fast as they grow.
paragraphs: My work centres on PHP and Laravel, backed by MySQL and solid front-end fundamentals in HTML, CSS and JavaScript. That mix lets me own a feature from the database all the way to the screen.
I approach every task by understanding the real problem first, then choosing the simplest design that will still hold up when the product, the traffic and the team get bigger.

projects.title: MediHub
projects.description: Smart Healthcare Prescription Desk — a multi-tenant hospital platform with e-prescriptions and AI interaction checks, a patient health vault, real-time care-team chat, an AI assistant grounded in hospital documents (RAG), RFID self check-in, and a Free / Paid billing engine.
projects.details: Coverage includes tenant isolation (queries, route-model binding, files, chat, AI retrieval, kiosks), RBAC for every role, prescription issuing / signing / QR verification, billing in Free and Paid Mode, real-time channel authorisation, RFID token security, and a check that every menu link opens for every role.

projects.title: Rivaaj — Pakistani Clothing E-Commerce Platform
projects.description: Storefront: home, shop with filters (price/size/colour/brand/rating), search with live suggestions, product pages with gallery zoom and variant picker.
projects.details: Admin panel: dashboard with charts, full product/category/brand catalog with variants & images, orders with status flow + invoices/packing slips (PDF), payments verification, returns/refunds, coupons, flash sales, banners, shipping (cities/provinces/couriers), finance (expenses + P&L reports, Excel/PDF/CSV export), inventory with stock history, CMS (pages/menus/FAQ/blog), contact inbox, reviews moderation, email templates with live preview + send test, SEO settings + redirect manager + 404 log, site settings, staff & role-based permissions, activity log.

projects.title: Student engagement with AI and Data Analytics
projects.description: Student engagement is an important factor in academic success. In online and blended learning environments, students interact with different activities
projects.details: This project proposes a web-based Student Engagement Analytics System using AI. The system will collect academic and activity data, calculate an engagement score, classify students into engagement levels, and show visual dashboards for teachers and students.
projects.imageAlt: Student engagement with AI and Data Analytics preview

projects.title: School Fee & Finance Manager
projects.description: A complete fee voucher, collection and finance management system for schools, with PDF, Email and WhatsApp reminders.
projects.details: School Fee & Finance Manager ek web-based system hai jo schools ke fee collection aur accounts ka poora kaam automate karta hai. Admin ek click mein monthly fee vouchers generate kar sakta hai, payments record kar sakta hai, aur income-expense ka live hisaab dekh sakta hai. Vouchers PDF mein download hote hain, aur parents ko Email ya WhatsApp se bheje ja sakte hain, reminders ke saath. System PKR currency, class-wise fee structure aur late-fine rules ko support karta hai.

projects.title: Smart Campus Management System
projects.description: Smart Campus Management System is a comprehensive web-based educational management platform designed to digitize and simplify daily academic and administrative activities within educational institutions.
projects.details: Smart Campus Management System is a complete role-based campus management solution that combines academic management, student information management, examination systems, attendance tracking, fee management, and administrative reporting into one centralized web application.
